title: The Brooklyn Pizza Crawl with Four Slices and Brews Add-On
includes: Enjoy generous portions at each stop — you'll have more than enough to eat!
Four slices of pizza, each with a different style
Option for a private tour available
Receive a digital map, full of recommendations from your local foodie guide
Small group capped at 10 for a personalized experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The best New York pizza is in Brooklyn — come eat it with us. On this small group experience in Brooklyn’s fast-growing Williamsburg, you’ll taste slices from four of NYC's finest pizzerias, each with their own style.

- Come hungry: you'll get more than enough pizza to fill you up

- Follow a local expert foodie in a small group capped at 10 to ensure a personalized experience

- There won't be any dollar slices here: each pizza has its own gourmet style, including everything from a quintessential gas oven New York slice to a coal-fired blend of New York, Naples and Sicily

- Opt for our brews add-on and enjoy two beer from local breweries as part of your afternoon

- The tour is an easy trip from Manhattan, just two subway stops into Brooklyn
